clues: Of the rower bound for Gull Rock and the one who pushed off at 3:30 p.m., one took out the Puffin and the other the Minnow.
Between Nico and whoever pushed off at 3:30 p.m., one rowed the Teacup and the other rowed the Minnow.
Either Felix or Imani pushed off at 3:00 p.m.
Felix pushed off at neither 2:00 p.m. nor 2:30 p.m.
Oscar's boat was neither the Minnow nor the Puffin.
The 3:30 p.m. rower went to neither East Cove nor the Narrows.
The Skipjack's rower pushed off at neither 2:00 p.m. nor 3:30 p.m.
Neither Oscar nor Imani pushed off at 2:30 p.m.
Teddy pushed off sometime after Felix.
Either Oscar or Imani rowed to Seal Ledge.
The rower headed for the Narrows pushed off earlier than the one headed for East Cove.
One of Nico and Felix rowed to Gull Rock, and the other rowed to the Narrows.
hints: Look at the 3:30 p.m. rower in clues 1 and 2. Which boat fits both?
Put pair clues 1 and 2 together, then clue 12. When the clues stall, the Minnow has just two possible rowers left: test one with a Suppose.
Suppose Imani took the Minnow, at 3:30 p.m. Clue 3 then puts Felix at 3:00 p.m., and clue 9 leaves Teddy no later time.
With Teddy at 3:30 p.m., clues 4 and 8 give 2:30 p.m. to Nico. Then clues 11 and 6 put East Cove at 3:00 p.m.

solution.key_idea: Supposing Imani took the Minnow puts her at 3:30 p.m. and Felix at 3:00 p.m., leaving Teddy no later time; so Teddy took it.
steps: Clue 1 gives the 3:30 p.m. rower the Puffin or Minnow; clue 2, the Teacup or Minnow. So the Minnow went at 3:30 p.m.
So Nico took the Teacup (clue 2), and the Puffin went to Gull Rock (clue 1).
Nico's Teacup did not go to Gull Rock, so clue 12 sends Nico to the Narrows and Felix to Gull Rock, in the Puffin.
Clue 5 rules out Oscar for the Minnow, and Nico and Felix have other boats. Suppose Imani took it, at 3:30 p.m. Then clue 3 puts Felix at 3:00 p.m.
But clue 9 needs Teddy after Felix, and 3:30 p.m. is taken. So Imani did not take the Minnow; Teddy did, at 3:30 p.m.
Clues 4 and 8 give Nico 2:30 p.m. Clues 6 and 10 keep Teddy from East Cove and Seal Ledge: he went to the Point.
East Cove came after Nico's Narrows (clue 11), so at 3:00 p.m. By clue 3 that was Imani, since Felix went to Gull Rock.
Clue 4 puts Felix at 1:30 p.m. and Oscar at 2:00 p.m., bound for Seal Ledge. Clue 7 gives Oscar the Pebble, Imani the Skipjack.
solution.epilogue: Teddy pushed off last, at 3:30 p.m., and rowed the Minnow to Thimble Point, camera in his lap and the spare key in his pocket. He was back at the boatyard by half past four.

answer_line: Teddy rowed out to Thimble Point.
